title: Start, stop and restart an animation
source: A3 Q1 · animation task
requirements: Use the practice student number 101. Create a web page that initially displays 1 + 101 = 102. Use inline CSS to make the equation red and 60px.
Display two clickable texts: "Start Animation" in orange and "Stop Animation" in purple.
When the user clicks Start Animation, update the equation every second. After one second, display 3 + 101 = 104. After another second, display 5 + 101 = 106. Continue with 7, 9, and so on.
When the user clicks Stop Animation, stop the updates and display the original equation: 1 + 101 = 102.
If the user clicks Start Animation again, start the sequence again with 3 after one second, then 5, 7, and so on.
checks: The first update occurs one second after Start, and the following updates are one second apart.
